articles.description:
Mantra DAO’s token OM dropped an eye-watering 95%, wiping out an estimated $6 billion in value in under an hour, marking the fastest and most severe single-asset collapse in DeFi history, second only to Terra LUNA’s fall from grace. This event will chant its way into crypto history books alongside LUNA, albeit for different reasons. […]
